name: Monti Lessini

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.
Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.
Indicazione Geografica Tipica, Italy's broad regional tier.
An aged Italian wine. Chianti Riserva needs at least 6 months in barrel and 3 more in bottle before release.

notes: Valpolicella is ruby when young and turns garnet with age.
Soave, from Garganega, is a fragrant white with fine lemon and almond flavor.
Merlot from the warm plains can be overripe, with a sweet-and-sour quality.
